post_update_notes: A large batch: a full audit of the Auth, Catalog, Marketing, CMS, Support, and System modules (89 findings, all fixed), a performance pass for the ~100k product catalog, a sweep for uncached/uninvalidated hot queries sitewide, a new opt-in Cloudflare CDN integration (purge-only), and an image optimization pipeline for uploads. Every migration applies automatically; every new behavior defaults to matching what the site already did. This is also the first release verified with a cryptographic signature (RSA-SHA256) — see CHANGELOG.md for the full list.
